description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionDao class responsible for data access operations related to email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, and saving email notification entities, interfacing with the database through a query builder and paginator.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing email subscription notifications, providing methods to query, count, retrieve by ID, and save email notification entities.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves an array of EmailNotification objects based on search filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object for email subscriptions matching the search filters, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of email subscriptions matching the search filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches a single EmailNotification entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists a given EmailNotification entity to the database and returns it.
